parts.text: boat trip in the afternoon 2 days ago for 7 adults

As a Tour agency, I need to create the invoice for my supplier about tour organizing. I need to understand the message from my staff to create the invoice for the tour. The tour is calculated as following fomula: base price is 800000 for a maximum group of 4 adults, additional adult is charged 100000, children under 11 is free of charge, however 5 children is charged as one adult, every person join the tour is charged 10000 coconut price as well. Sometimes, the tour includes the tuktuk transportation for 120000 for one way. Each item should have a meaningful name not too short. The time should be in format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss and it is in ICT timezone. The date should be generated based on execution date. The invoice description should contains world morning or afternoon and the day based on the time for example "Tour Mekong morning 31.12.2024". Each item has a service field with value TOUR
